object: /docs/ as a universal read-only projection over same-origin repository text files

before.docs: A curated shelf of 14 control documents; the Aperture worked well once a file was selected.
before.raw_links: Global route-adapter MANIFEST / RECEIPT / ACTION LAW / FI LAW links opened repository files directly.
before.gap: The reader capability was good but addressability was not general; arbitrary repo JSON/Markdown still required raw-browser reading or manual shelf wiring.

operation: Add ?src=/path.ext ingress for same-origin text-like repository files.
Preserve exact canonical source URL as RAW rather than copying or rewriting the document.
Add optional ?return=/caller and visible RETURN without changing document state.
Add compact ADDRESS input so an unlisted repo file can be opened directly.
Route global showcase-nav MANIFEST / text-like RECEIPT / ACTION LAW / FI LAW links through DOCS by default.
Keep non-text-like or external receipt links unchanged.
Add browser smoke for direct source ingress.

after.canonical_loop: FILE URL → DOCS projection → APERTURE scale/position/time → RAW or RETURN
after.source_allowlist: same-origin paths ending json/md/txt/csv/log/yaml/yml/js/mjs/css/html/svg inside DOCS; global route adapter wraps json/md/txt/csv/log/yaml/yml metadata links

non_claims: DOCS does not become canonical storage.
Material orientation cues are not semantic importance.
Opening a receipt through DOCS does not alter the receipt.
The curated shelf remains useful for common entry points; arbitrary addressing does not replace it.

verification.static: PASS — route grammar, static surface contracts, LensState laws, Lens proof syntax and shared Constraint Surface parity
verification.recovered_source_tests: PASS — recovered source identities/media catalogue and frozen City/Painting handlers

next: Use repository document links normally. If addressability reduces raw-JSON friction, retain. Do not add richer rendering until a specific document type exposes a missing operation.
